title: Principal Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Principal Data Engineer Who is Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. Overview The Global Business Solution Center (GBSC) Tech team is looking for a Principal Data Engineer to steer and implement key projects related to Big Data solutions across Mastercard’s cloud and on-prem ecosystem. The ideal candidate is highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical with a passion for reliability, scalability and automation. Principal Data Engineer

ROLE:
• Serve as the GBSC’s subject matter expert (SME) on Data Engineering best practices and solution design • Charged with designing and building scalable data pipelines and data storage schemas across Mastercard’s evolving on-prem and cloud data management ecosystem • Define and evangelize reference architectures, design patterns, and engineering standards for data ingestion, transformation, storage, and consumption. • Stays abreast of Mastercard’s data management ecosystem (e.g. Azure Data Fabric, Cloudera, Databricks , Apache Ozone, AWS S3, etc.) • Collaborates with stakeholders to translate data needs into scalable, ingestible data storage & schema solutions • Ensure data solutions align with enterprise governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards by design • Mentors team members by sharing best practices, innovative techniques, and emerging trends to develop expertise and capabilities around their discipline All About You: • Demonstrated experience designing and building end to end data pipelines using ETL/ELT patterns. • Hands on experience with data lake, lake house, and/or data warehouse architectures, including schema design and performance optimization. • Strong working knowledge of data modeling concepts (dimensional, normalized, and analytical models). • Expert level proficiency in Python, Java or equivalent for building robust, production grade data systems. • Advanced SQL expertise, including performance tuning for very large and complex datasets. • Deep hands-on experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark or equivalent) • Deep hands-on experience with platforms like Azure Data Fabric, Databricks, etc. • Detail oriented with a passion for automation, adopting emerging technologies and applying industry best practices to data architectures and pipelines • Excels working on a global team, communicating plans and leading execution across time zones Desirable Capabilities • Background in financial services, payments, or other high scale, high reliability domains • Strong communication skills / experience communicating with senior leaders and executives • Previous leadership experience leading a global team Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. CERT) and vulnerability management • Understands the basic engineering principles used in building and running mission critical software capabilities (security, customer experience, testing, operability, simplification, service-oriented architecture) • Understands internals of operating systems (Windows, Linux) to write interoperable and performant code • Able to perform debugging and troubleshooting to analyze core, heap, thread dumps and remove coding errors • Understands and implements standard branching (e.g., Gitflow) and peer review practices • Has skills in test driven and behavior driven development (TDD and BDD) to build just enough code and collaborate on the desired functionality • Understands use cases for advanced design patterns (e.g., service-to-worker, MVC, API gateway, intercepting filter, dependency injection, lazy loading, all from the gang of four) to implement efficient code • Understands and implements Application Programming Interface (API) standards and cataloging to drive API/service adoption and commercialization • Has skills to author test code with lots of smaller tests followed by few contract tests at service level and fewer journey tests skills to collaborate with team and business stakeholders to estimate requirements (e.g., story pointing) and prioritize based on business value • Has skills to elaborate and estimate non-functional requirements, including security (e.g., data protection, authentication, authorization), regulatory, and performance (SLAs, throughput, transactions per second) • Has skills to orchestrate release workflows and pipelines, and apply standardized pipelines via APIs to achieve CI and CD using industry standard tools (e.g., Jenkins, AWS/Azure pipelines, XL Release, others). • Has skills to understand, report, and optimize delivery metrics to continuously improve upon them (e.g., velocity, throughput, lead time, defect leakage, burndown) • Has skills to document and drive definition-of-done for requirements to meet both business and operational needs • Understands how to build robust tests to minimize defect leakage by performing regression, performance, deployment verification, and release testing • Has skills to conduct product demos and co-ordinate with product owners to drive product acceptance signoffs • Has skills to Understands customer journeys and ensure a Mastercard good experience by continuously reducing Mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for incidents and ensuring high availability (99.99% as a starting point) Corporate Security Responsibility accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. title: Manager, Finance Business Partner
jobDescription:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Manager, Finance Business Partner Overview: Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. The Financial Planning & Analysis function manages all aspects of management reporting encompassing budgeting and forecasting, strategic and customer planning. This includes the management and execution of the corporate reporting and planning requirements This Manger position is responsible across a broad spectrum of strategic processes and initiatives while managing and executing the corporate reporting and planning requirements

ROLE:
• Lead the financial close process through the analysis of variances against budget, forecasts, prior year actuals, key business drivers and initiatives. Review and provide thoughtful business driven commentary to respective management teams • Drive the development of the annual plan/budget, forecast and opportunities & risks. Also be responsible for ensuring accurate data upload into Hyperion budgeting and forecasting tool • Manage, develop and create standardized financial reporting packages that will help drive and support the business, inclusive of business metrics/KPIs. Also identify and communicate revenue risks and opportunities and review and respond promptly to ad-hoc requests for information and analysis • Develop presentations for quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and quarterly operating reviews (QORs), as well as ad hoc presentation • Drive Mastercard strategic plans by providing relevant financial analytics and business insights to key stakeholders, while developing robust tracking mechanisms • Apply strategic understanding of business dynamics and competitive forces in different markets and supporting business to formulate mitigating strategies • Execute on financial process improvements by building and maintaining financial tools to perform analysis and modeling; review and create suggestions to financial systems • Investigate and create opportunities for automation and more efficient methods of creation and delivery anticipating needs of internal customers, members and other stakeholders • Lead special projects as they arise • Guide and Mentor the team All About You: • Educational qualification
- Chartered Accountant or CPA or MBA Finance • Experience in varied financial roles with advanced knowledge and experience with all phases of financial planning and management • Good knowledge of Business Intelligence tools and experience with financial systems/applications (e.g. Hyperion and Oracle) • Good understanding of reporting, forecasting and budgeting techniques. • Strong analytical and proven problem solving skills • Self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering success while operating in a team environment. • Good influencing skills, she/he must be able to communicate and present to the management team, she/he must also be persuasive with a considerate but firm touch • Good work ethics, hands-on, meticulous, but also be able to step back and see the bigger strategic picture. • Strong relationship management and networking skills. • Maturity to challenge ideas and balance opportunities and threats. • Ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency and accuracy • Ability to manage multiple activities of different nature in a condensed timeframe Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities. Services within Mastercard Services is Mastercard's professional services arm, focused on driving value beyond payment transactions. We harness the power of our transaction data, deep payments expertise and vast network of merchant and FI partners to offer holistic solutions to our customers. Our solutions comprise consulting; data insights; marketing services; loyalty and analytics; security solutions; and more. Discover more at www.mastercardservices.com/en. Insights & Enablement within Services The Insights & Enablement team ensures we have the right infrastructure and tools to enable data-driven decisions and optimize productivity. We partner across Services to enhance reporting insights, increase efficiency, and automate processes. - Selling. Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Sr. Analyst – Treasury Management System (“TMS”) Implementation Manager Job Title: Sr. Analyst – Treasury Management System (“TMS”) Implementation Manager | Mastercard Location: Pune/Gurugram Overview: Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry, with a mission to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Operating in more than 200 countries and territories, we power economies and empower people through our secure network, technology, innovation, and partnerships. Together with our customers, we enable individuals, businesses, and governments to realize their greatest potential, advancing financial inclusion, unlocking economic opportunities, and transforming how money moves. At Mastercard, you’re not just part of a company, you’re helping shape the future of the global payments ecosystem and building a sustainable world where everyone can prosper. Role Overview: We are on a journey to build the next generation of digital Treasury—enabling real-time cash visibility, seamless cash movement, and a fully integrated, data-driven treasury ecosystem. This role will be part of a team shaping the future digital landscape for Mastercard’s global Treasury organization. The position sits at the intersection of Treasury, Finance, and Technology, and will play a key role in delivering strategic transformation initiatives. The Senior Analyst will support the tasks related to the implementation of Treasury Management System (TMS) solutions, driving standardization across bank account database, process optimization, and data integration. This role requires a strong blend of domain expertise, systems implementation experience, and stakeholder management to successfully execute complex, multi-bank programs and deliver meaningful impact on a global scale. What You’ll Do • Execute TMS implementation activities, including data validation, UAT testing, and defect tracking • Lead discussions with partner banks and internal stakeholders to drive SWIFT onboarding, file integrations, and ongoing issue resolutions • Validate bank account database and statement reporting outputs across systems • Provide regular project tracking, status reporting, and progress updates, ensuring clear visibility of milestones, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders • Support bank account rationalization and process standardization initiatives What You Bring • Experience in Treasury, Banking, or Financial Services • Exposure to TMS implementation, bank connectivity, or payments • Strong experience in data validation, UAT, and stakeholder coordination • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field Nice to have: ION (Reval/IBAM), SWIFT integration, ISO 20022 (camt.052/053/054), ERP systems What would it take to succeed in this

ROLE:
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment • Effective stakeholder communication and executive reporting Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. title: Manager, SME Channel Distribution Activation Specialist
jobDescription:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Manager, SME Channel Distribution Activation Specialist Overview Across Asia Pacific, Small and Medium Businesses (SMEs) are essential to economic growth, contributing significantly to employment and GDP. An increasing share of SMEs are adopting financial service products and services via non-traditional channels which include platforms, marketplaces, consumer packaged goods, and trade and logistics companies. Mastercard is committed to helping SMEs grow and thrive in a digital-first economy, by delivering customer-centric solutions through these emerging channels. Role Our SME team is looking for a Manager, SME Channel Distribution Activation Specialist in India to drive revenue growth and expand Mastercard’s presence in this high-growth area. This role will focus on partner activation, and revenue realization through emerging distribution channels. You will work closely with the SME Sales Specialist and Channel Distribution teams, Account Management, Business Development, SME regional product managers, and key market stakeholders to accelerate activation, grow volumes and revenue, and deliver strong customer outcomes. Key Responsibilities
- Own and execute the activation strategy for South Asia, where new B2B payment flow opportunities are emerging and partner-led distribution models are gaining momentum.
- Drive market expansion by identifying unmet SME needs and translating them into scalable commercial opportunities, with a strong focus on partner activation.
- Build and maintain a robust activation pipeline and accelerate time to activation.
- Work closely with SME Sales Specialist and Channel Distribution teams, Account Management, Business Development, and Product teams to shape partner propositions, articulate clear business cases, and accelerate deal closure, activation, and revenue realisation. All About You The ideal candidate for this position should: • Create customer-centric solutions and be passionate about supporting SME growth. • Possess a strong track record of achievement in a sales and activation position. • Have proven experience engaging internal and external commercial and technical stakeholders to drive solution development and adoption. • Have a strong activation background, with experience in pipeline management, activation and revenue growth. • Have experience in financial services and/or payments, with an understanding of competitive offerings, industry trends, and profitability drivers. • Have strong relationship management, collaboration, influencing, and communication skills. • Be self-motivated, a quick learner, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. • Able to navigate working in a high growth, global organisation. • Hold a Bachelor’s degree. • Proficiency in the English. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. title: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis
jobDescription: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager, Financial Planning and Analysis About Mastercard? Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function manages all aspects of management reporting encompassing budgeting and forecasting, strategic and customer planning. This includes the management and execution of the corporate reporting and planning requirements. Business Finance Centre provides FP&A expertise to the organization by compiling and analysing metrics, identifying trends and problems, communicating information to relevant groups, and recommending actions to improve financial performance. Revenue Assurance (RA) is a function within Finance responsible for strengthening revenue controls, identifying billing opportunities, and minimizing revenue leakage across QMR (Quarterly Mastercard Reported), regional billing processes, and billing reviews of revenue streams across core and services. The role focuses on ensuring billing accuracy, driving revenue recovery, and partnering with cross-functional teams to enhance revenue integrity and controls. This position will report to Director, Revenue Assurance, and is responsible for driving data analytics excellence for revenue assurance function. Roles and Responsibilities • Lead and own revenue assurance review projects to identify billing leakages and ensure billing completeness and accuracy. • Working with billing on understanding rules, determining if there are any billing issues, working through the back billing, and working through system fixes • Perform in-depth analysis of data systems and process flows to identify and resolve root causes of revenue leakage. Conduct rigorous data analysis from Mastercard databases to identify, research, and resolve revenue leakage; synthesize findings into actional insights and recommendations • Understand and validate billing logic by recreating billing from core systems and comparing it with actual billed amounts. • To work with the pricing teams to see any gaps in pricing or understanding the intent of pricing to determine if we are billing on what we intended to bill on. • Perform on-site or virtual QMR audits and analysis for assigned customers/countries using standardized audit frameworks. Complete pre and post audit documentation and issue QMR observation letter to customer. • Develop risk-based prioritization plans for revenue stream reviews based on materiality, business inputs, and new initiatives • Perform financial analysis to estimate revenue impact at customer and country levels and support recovery decisions. • Collaborate with Finance, Product, and GBSC teams to improve billing accuracy, implement fixes, and execute back-billing. • Communicate identified revenue leakage opportunities, recovery actions/waivers to Regional Finance team and senior stakeholders. • Act as a regional Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all billing related matters and ensure alignment with corporate Revenue Assurance strategies. • Obtain clear understanding of selected customers, customer’s incentive & deal agreements, market regulations and structures, and key players (such as processors, issuers, and acquirers) as part of pre-audit process. Requires interviews and discussions with internal and external sources to gather knowledge. • Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions • Contribute to the Global Revenue Assurance strategies, initiatives, and efforts as the regional Subject Matter Expert representative •Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions All about you: • CA/MBA (Finance preferred) with 8+ years of relevant experience; CPA/CFA certification is an added advantage. Strong proficiency in database management, Microsoft Office applications, and data analytics. • Demonstrated success in Revenue Assurance, with the ability to thrive in project-based roles requiring self-initiative and self-motivation. • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify and articulate complex issues effectively. • Structured, proactive problem-solver with a strong focus on process improvement and execution. • High degree of ownership, business acumen, and entrepreneurial mindset. • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across teams and all management levels. • Proven ability to manage time-sensitive matters, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. • Capable of handling multiple priorities simultaneously while working effectively with cross-functional partners. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. Proven ability to lead data strategy and unify fragmented ecosystems in complex organizations. • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with master data domains relevant to the financial services and technology industries—such as merchant, customer, consumer, product, and financial master data—is preferred. • Leadership: Implement MDM and governance frameworks, collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive change. • Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. title: Research Analyst - Primary Market Research, Data Processing
jobDescription:
Research Analyst – Primary Market Research, Data Processing Location: Gurgaon, India Team: Advisors Research Center (ARC) – Global Facilities India (GFI) Overview The Advisors Research Center (ARC) is a global team of researchers within Mastercard that delivers high‑quality, end‑to‑end research in support of Mastercard’s Advisory and Consulting Services. As part of ARC’s continued growth, Global Facilities India (GFI) supports global and regional ARC engagements by providing scalable, high‑quality quantitative research delivery. The GFI team works closely with ARC researchers and consultants to ensure consistency, speed, and quality across research execution and outputs. This role sits within the ARC Quant Research capability in GFI and supports the preparation, processing, and quality assurance of quantitative research data for global projects

ROLE:
As a Quantitative Research Data Processing Specialist, you will support data processing workstreams across quantitative research projects. You will be responsible for preparing clean, structured, and analysis-ready datasets, applying quality checks, and supporting basic analytical outputs in partnership with senior team members. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Perform data cleaning, validation, and preparation of survey datasets for analysis
- Review in￼field and post￼field data to identify issues such as outliers, missing data, or inconsistencies
- Execute data transformations, including dataset merging, recoding, and variable creation following defined processing standards
- Produce standard analytical outputs (e.g., distributions, cross‑tabs) following defined template
- Flag data issues, missing variables, or anomalies and collaborate with project managers and programming teams to resolve them
- Maintain clear documentation, codebooks, and processing notes
- Ingest and review structured survey datasets received from fieldwork / project teams for completeness and usability
- Validate dataset structure, variable definitions, coding schemes, and alignment with questionnaire specifications
- Review, assess, and validate the tabulation plan (tab plan) developed by the ARC team.
- Partner with fieldwork, scripting, and visualization teams to ensure smooth handoffs and data continuity across project stages
- Ensure final datasets meet internal quality standards and are optimized for downstream analysis and reporting Qualifications & Skills:
- At least 5 years’ experience at a research agency or in an in-house role supporting quantitative research data processing
- Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Hands-on experience with data processing or statistical tools (e.g., SPSS, Q, R, Excel, Display R, or similar) is mandatory
- Understanding of quantitative research data structures and processing workflows
- Familiarity with basic analytical concepts and outputs (e.g., data weighting, distributions, crosstabs, basic comparisons
- Strong attention to detail and quality orientation
- Ability to manage multiple datasets and tasks simultaneously
- Comfortable working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments
- Experience supporting multi-market or regional studies is a plus All About You
- Detail‑oriented and focused on delivering accurate, well‑structured datasets
- Comfortable owning defined data processing workstreams from raw data to final outputs
- Methodical in applying data quality checks, logic rules, and consistency validations
- Confident working with structured datasets, codebooks, and processing documentation
- Collaborative and reliable in supporting researchers, programmers, and visualization teams
- Able to balance speed with rigor in a high‑volume, deadline‑driven environment Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. All About You Education & Experience: • Strong academic background in Computer Science, Data Science, Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field—or equivalent work experience. • Experience in data management, mining, analytics, reporting, product development, and quantitative analysis. Technical Skills: • Proficiency in Python, Spark, Hadoop platforms (Hive, Impala, Airflow, Ni Fi), and SQL. • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks, libraries, data structures, and software architecture. • Experience with BI platforms like Tableau or Power BI is a plus. Analytical & Communication Skills: • Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to translate data into compelling insights. • Experience interacting with stakeholders to understand technical needs and deliver effective solutions. • Ability to articulate the business value of products and contribute to sales enablement. Work Style: • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. • Effective as both a team player and an individual contributor. Title and Summary Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy The Enterprise Data Quality (EDQ) team, part of the AI & Data Office, is responsible for advancing Mastercard’s data quality program and ensuring data is trusted, accurate, and business-ready. As a Senior Analyst, the role drives data quality validation, price monitoring, and insight generation using SQL, ETL tools, and cloud platforms. It requires close collaboration with GCO Compliance, data strategy, engineering, and business teams to ensure high-quality external data integration and adherence to governance standards. The position plays a key role in enabling compliance, improving reporting accuracy, and supporting data-driven innovation. Role As a Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy you will:
- Execute data quality and pricing monitoring initiatives by partnering with GCO Compliance, data strategy leads, business SMEs, and stakeholders to identify gaps, validate requirements, and deliver actionable, compliance-aligned insights.
- Perform advanced data analysis using SQL, cloud platforms, and automation tools; continuously refine outputs to drive meaningful business decisions.
- Lead the design and development of data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows across cloud and on-prem systems, while supporting GCO pricing strategy execution and monitoring.
- Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and documentation to track data quality, pricing metrics, and key performance indicators.
- Support strategic GCO compliance and pricing decisions by gathering requirements, validating use cases, and assessing data readiness for enterprise initiatives.
- Collaborate with business and technical teams to execute workflows, ensure data pipeline reliability, and monitor performance.
- Contribute to data modernization efforts by recommending enhancements to data processes, governance frameworks, and security capabilities to enable advanced analytics and innovation.
- Create training materials and deliver knowledge sessions to drive adoption of tools, processes, and best practices. All About You
- Strong understanding of data analysis, data ecosystems, and data management principles.
- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Hands-on experience with data ingestion, ETL processes, and workflow automation.
- Familiarity with cloud architectures (preferably Databricks), data marketplaces, and emerging technologies such as AI/ML.
- Proficiency in SQL, with working knowledge of Python, Spark, and Hadoop; experience in data wrangling, entity matching, and ETL methodologies.
- Understanding of cloud-based data storage and processing technologies.
- Experience with data visualization tools (preferably Power BI) and operational data management best practices.
- Ability to execute operational tasks while driving process improvements and coordinating cross-functional initiatives.
- Strong intellectual curiosity with a structured, process-driven approach to solving business problems.
- Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term architectural goals with short-term business priorities.
- Demonstrated passion for innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement.
- Familiarity with Mastercard products and systems is a plus. title: Site Reliability Engineer II
jobDescription: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Site Reliability Engineer II Overview-The Decision Management Biz Ops team is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who can help us solve problems, build our CI/CD pipeline and lead Mastercard in Dev Ops automation and best practices. • Are you a born problem solver who loves to figure out how something works? • Are you a CI/CD geek who loves all things automation? • Do you have a low tolerance for manual work and look to automate everything you can? Business Operations is leading the Dev Ops transformation at Mastercard through our tooling and by being an advocate for change & standards throughout the development, quality, release, and product organizations. We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize needs and to build relationships is a must. Mission The role of business operations is to be the production readiness steward for the platform. This is accomplished by closely partnering with developers to design, build, implement, and support technology services. A business operations engineer will ensure operational criteria like system availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, self-healing, and deployment automation are implemented throughout the delivery process. Business Operations plays a key role in leading the Dev Ops transformation at Mastercard through our tooling and by being an advocate for change and standards throughout the development, quality, release, and product organizations. We accomplish this transformation through supporting daily operations with a hyper focus on triage and then root cause by understanding the business impact of our products. The goal of every biz ops team is to shift left to be more proactive and upfront in the development process, and to proactively manage production and change activities to maximize customer experience, and increase the overall value of supported applications. Biz Ops teams also focus on risk management by tying all our activities together with an overarching responsibility for compliance and risk mitigation across all our environments. A biz ops focus is also on streamlining and standardizing traditional application specific support activities and centralizing points of interaction for both internal and external partners by communicating effectively with all key stakeholders. Ultimately, the role of biz ops is to align Product and Customer Focused priorities with Operational needs. We regularly review our run state not only from an internal perspective, but also understanding and providing the feedback loop to our development partners on how we can improve the customer experience of our applications. Responsibilities • Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement. • Analyze ITSM activities of the platform and provide feedback loop to development teams on operational gaps or resiliency concerns • Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews. • Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health. • Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity. • Support the application CI/CD pipeline for promoting software into higher environments through validation and operational gating, and lead Mastercard in Dev Ops automation and best practices. • Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems. • Take a holistic approach to problem solving, by connecting the dots during a production event thru the various technology stack that makes up the platform, to optimize mean time to recover • Work with a global team spread across tech hubs in multiple geographies and time zones • Share knowledge and mentor junior resources Qualifications • BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent practical experience. • Experience with algorithms, data structures, scripting, pipeline management, and software design. • Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive. • Ability to help debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks. • We support many different stakeholders. Experience in dealing with difficult situations and making decisions with a sense of urgency is needed. • Experience in one or more of the following is preferred: C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Perl or Ruby. • Interest in designing, analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems. • We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize needs and to build relationships is a must. • Experience in industry standard CI/CD tools like Git/Bit Bucket, Jenkins, Maven, Artifactory, and Chef. Experience designing and implementing an effective and efficient CI/CD flow that gets code from dev to prod with high quality and minimal manual effort is desired. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. Background in developing and maintaining security policies, processes, procedures, and standards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for the design, creation, and testing of security controls and systems. Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; a degree in Information Systems Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred. masking, and secure data handling processes for sensitive and regulated data. • Support secure file transfer mechanisms and integrations using SFTP, managed file transfer solutions, APIs, and cloud-native services. • Develop resilient data recovery, disaster recovery, and operational support processes across critical data platforms. • Support production environments through incident title: Analyst, Global Product Enablement
jobDescription: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Analyst, Global Product Enablement Overview The Global Product Enablement team is seeking an Analyst of Global Product Enablement to support the successful, consistent, and scalable integration of new or significantly enhanced solutions. The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, organized, collaborative, and motivated to learn how products are enabled for global customer delivery teams. This role is well suited for someone who can support cross-functional initiatives, help translate product and implementation information into clear documentation and enablement materials, and contribute to process improvements that support speed, quality, and predictability. This position requires strong communication, attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Regional Delivery, and other Mastercard teams. The person in this role will support senior team members in preparing delivery documentation, coordinating enablement activities, gathering feedback, tracking actions, and helping ensure delivery teams have the knowledge, tools, and resources needed to support customer onboarding. ◦ Are you curious about how new products and services are prepared for customer delivery? ◦ Do you want to build a global perspective and learn how Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams work together? ◦ Are you passionate about improving processes, documentation, and the customer onboarding experience? ◦ Are you comfortable working with data, feedback, and stakeholder input to identify trends and improvement opportunities? ◦ Do you enjoy collaborating with others, learning new concepts, and turning complex information into clear, practical materials? The Global Product Enablement (GPE) team is part of the Global Customer Delivery & Care organization. Focusing on new products and services, the Global Product Enablement team collaborates with product owners, development teams, and other stakeholders across Mastercard to deploy solutions efficiently and effectively with speed, quality, and predictability. GPE supports Regional Customer Delivery teams by developing the necessary processes, documentation, tools, and knowledge resources to scale products and solutions at an accelerated pace. GPE creates streamlined and straightforward processes used globally by our delivery teams, resulting in a positive implementation experience for both customers and employees. Additionally, GPE supports product readiness and the implementation of key frameworks by our partners to provide best-in-class customer experience, utilizing key data, insights, and feedback for continual improvement. Role & responsibilities o Support discussions with Global Product and Engineering owners by helping capture delivery requirements, actions, decisions, and regional feedback needed to support Studio Framework Excellence and product integration readiness. o Support low to medium complexity initiatives by coordinating tasks, tracking progress, preparing materials, and escalating risks or open questions as needed. o Partner with regional delivery teams to help provide the knowledge, support, tools, processes, and documentation needed to perform their job functions efficiently and effectively. o Assist in preparing and maintaining training materials, implementation guides, process documentation, task lists, and knowledge resources for regional customer delivery teams. o Help coordinate product enablement activities, including meeting preparation, action tracking, follow-ups, and readiness checkpoints. o Support product integration efforts through the global Studio process in collaboration with global product owners, technology teams, and other stakeholders. o Contribute to the ongoing improvement of GPE standards, methodology, documentation quality, and ways of working. o Assist with collecting, organizing, and analyzing feedback, data, and insights to identify opportunities to improve the customer onboarding and delivery experience. o Collaborate with partners across Mastercard to support integrated, automated, and scalable tools and reporting that enhance delivery efficiency and customer experience. All About You o Foundational experience or strong interest in payments, processing, customer delivery, implementation, product enablement, or related business operations. o Basic understanding of the payment ecosystem, product lifecycle, customer onboarding, and hand-offs across Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Support teams. o Experience supporting projects, initiatives, process improvements, documentation, training, or operational readiness activities. o Ability to understand, organize, simplify, and clearly communicate business and technical information. o Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, and ability to follow through on actions and commitments. o Comfortable working in a matrixed, global organization with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities. o Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collect information, identify patterns, and propose practical improvements. o Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to create clear documentation and support enablement or training activities. o Ability to build positive working relationships with internal teams, business partners, and stakeholders at different levels of the organization. o Curious about technology and motivated to learn new products, processes, tools, and ways of working. o Team player with a willingness to share knowledge, ask questions, and support others. o Self-starter who can work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance when needed. o Experience with project coordination, process documentation, data analysis, or reporting tools is a plus. o Project management exposure or certification is a plus, such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar. o Process improvement exposure, such as Lean, Six Sigma, SAFe, or similar, is a plus. o Language skills are a plus, as the role works with regional teams. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. jobDescription:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Title and Summary Manager, People Business Partner Title: Manager People Business Partner (HRBP), Pune Job Overview: This position has responsibility for facilitating People & Capability (P&C) (Human Resources) related activities within Master Card, Pune. Responsibilities include implementation of P&C initiatives, and core human resources activities. The Manager People Business Partner will act as a positive cultural change agent, consultant and business advisor in partnering with employees and managers to enable the execution of business strategies and initiatives. The individual in this role will need to work in close collaboration with assigned Business Units and Regional colleagues to execute on initiatives. Major Accountabilities: The individual in this role will execute on strategic initiatives designed to enhance P&C effectiveness and delivery. This individual will be responsible for managing and performing a wide range of P&C activities for the groups that s/he supports. These activities include, but are not limited to: • Manage the day-to-day aspects of one or more complex projects; partners with key stakeholders across Business Unit and Master Card at large to ensure the timely coordination and execution of plans and activities • Participate in the Talent Acquisition process for the function as appropriate • Coach employees and managers on a wide range of issues • Facilitate job evaluation and compensation assessment as needed • Partner with Business Unit executives and Finance to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the budget and headcount planning and tracking process • Participate in the talent review process including leadership development and succession planning, skills assessment and organization design • Participate in the facilitation of the Performance Management process, including the administration of the year-end compensation process, goal setting and ratings calibration • Process involuntary terminations as needed and prepare paperwork for legal review; manage pre and post termination issues and guide Manager through process • Participate in Employee Relations activities in partnership with the SR PBP Experience and

EDUCATION:
• Demonstrated People Business Partner (HRBP) experience • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree and/or certification in HR preferred • Core knowledge of HR principles, theories and concepts • Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives exercising sound judgment, solutions orientation and flexibility • Must demonstrate the ability to work cross functionally and across multiple geographies • Must have good influencing skills • Must have strong analytical, presentation, verbal and written communications skills
- AI fluency preferred • Previous experience managing HR initiatives for innovation and technology functions/teams preferred Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. Title and Summary Manager Software Engineering Job Description
- Overview • Payment Enablement and Optimization group is building a Product Express that will define Mastercard’s strategy and roadmap for onboarding Fin Techs in different regions across globe. Building a website that will help to fintech and partners to get the status of their onboarding request status. • We focus on delivering digital solutions across different digital channels (web, social media, mobile.) • This position is responsible for providing application development and design support within Digital Consumer Solutions. - Develop application code and unit test in the Angular, Rest Web Services, Spring Boot and Java technologies
- Develop and Lead User interfaces for Modern Rich Internet Applications with the latest Node JS based Front End Technologies like Stencil, Angular, React or Vue
- Perform product analysis and development tasks of increasingly complex nature which may require extensive research and analysis.
- Ensure high performance applications which are secure and scalable
- Strong expertise with HTML, CSS, JS and writing cross-browser compatible code.
- Good understanding of AJAX and Java Script Dom manipulation techniques
- Experience with RESTful services
- Responsible for leading design & development of micro-services built using Sprint-boot on Cloud.
- Integrate content feeds via API, JSON, XML, and RSS from both internal and external sources.
- Hands-on design & development experience on Cloud. Exposure to Pivotal Cloud Foundry will be an added advantage.
- Experience in Java Script build tools like grunt or gulp
- Familiar with testing frameworks (Ex. JUnit, Jest, Jasmine)
- Test runner framework (Ex. Karma)
- Document application components for support and training materials for Master Card Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes. Need to have strong knowledge in one or more of the technology skills above and exposure to the other skills enough to learn on the job and scale to pick up responsibility of a full stack developer. All About You • Strong communication skills – both verbal and written – with strong relationship building, collaborative skills and organisational skills. • Ability to work as a member of a matrix-based, diverse and geographically distributed project team. • Demonstrate ethics and values to generate high team trust. Title and Summary Specialist, Product Management Job Overview: Support product operations and enhancement workstreams with a strong focus on data-driven decision making and data governance excellence. Product operations include go-to-market planning, user onboarding, platform maintenance, and continuous improvement of data quality, usability, and insights delivery across the product ecosystem. Drive data governance initiatives within the product, including defining data quality standards, validation frameworks, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of insights delivered to customers. Leverage SQL and Python to perform data analysis, validate product outputs, troubleshoot data issues, and automate recurring reporting and operational workflows. Automate and enhance recurring processes using AI agents and intelligent workflows, including feedback collection, usage analysis, reporting, and prioritization pipelines. Simplify and scale feedback management and reporting processes through AI-based workflows, enabling structured ingestion, categorization, and actioning of user feedback. Coordinate product discussions on data insights, feedback trends, and product usage metrics across product, engineering, and regional teams to drive aligned decision-making. Monitor and analyze product performance metrics, data quality KPIs, and usage trends across all stages of the product lifecycle, and recommend data-backed solutions to address gaps or improve performance. Support global product management efforts by providing analytical and governance-driven inputs into strategic business plans and product roadmaps. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior Specialist, HR Services Role Summary: We are seeking a Senior Specialist, HR Services – Global Mobility (GBSC) to support end-to-end delivery of mobility services within a centralized shared services model. This role is responsible for managing complex global mobility cases, ensuring compliance and policy adherence, and driving operational excellence across relocation, global immigration, and assignment processes. The position plays a critical role in vendor coordination, and maintaining control, documentation, and audit readiness across mobility operations, while partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders and our COE. What We’re Looking For: • Strong understanding of: • Global mobility policies and program management • Global immigration support and relocation processes • Experience in Global Mobility & HR Operations / Shared Services environment • Proven ability to handle complex, sensitive, or escalated employee cases • High attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy, compliance, and risk awareness • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple cases/workstreams simultaneously • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data-driven decision making • Excellent verbal and written communication skills • Ownership mindset with ability to drive resolution independently while escalating appropriately when needed Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Manage complex, non-standard, and high-risk mobility cases across relocation, immigration, and assignment programs • Support global mobility programs including relocation, immigration, international assignments, and policy-driven employee moves • Deliver a high-quality employee experience by providing clear guidance on policies, processes, and mobility programs • Ensure consistent application of policies across regions while managing exceptions and non-standard scenarios • Partner with internal teams to ensure smooth execution across the employee lifecycle and global transitions • Ensure adherence to mobility policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards • Collaborate with People Business Partners, Payroll, Legal, cross-functional teams and vendors to drive end-to-end case resolution • Leverage data and reporting to identify trends, risks, and process improvements • Manage vendor interactions related to mobility services, ensuring service delivery and issue resolution • Maintain accuracy and governance in case management, documentation, and systems. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. title: Lead AI Security Engineer, AI Identities
jobDescription: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Lead AI Security Engineer, AI Identities Job Description Summary As an Information Security Engineer – AI Identity Security, you will be responsible for securing the identities associated with AI systems, including models, agents, services, pipelines, and non‑human actors that interact with data, infrastructure, and other systems. This role focuses on the discovery, lifecycle management, control enforcement, and monitoring of AI identities to ensure they are properly governed, least‑privileged, and continuously assessed for risk. Key Responsibilities AI Identity Discovery & Inventory • Design and operate mechanisms to discover and inventory AI identities, including: o AI models, agents, and autonomous workflows o Service accounts, non‑human identities, and API principals used by AI systems o Identities created dynamically through AI pipelines, orchestration tools, and integrations • Maintain authoritative visibility into where AI identities exist, what they can access, and how they are used across environments. • Integrate AI identity discovery into broader identity, asset, and AI Security Posture Management (AI‑SPM) capabilities. AI Identity Lifecycle Management • Define and operationalize lifecycle controls for AI identities, including creation, modification, rotation, suspension, and decommissioning. • Ensure AI identities are created with strong provenance, ownership, and accountability, including linkage to business and technical owners. • Implement controls to prevent identity sprawl, orphaned AI identities, and unmanaged credentials. Access Control & Policy Enforcement • Design and enforce least‑privilege access models for AI identities, aligned with the sensitivity of data, models, and actions performed. • Partner with IAM and platform teams to implement policy‑based access controls, including role‑based, attribute‑based, and context‑aware authorization for AI systems. • Ensure AI identities comply with enterprise security standards for authentication strength, credential handling, and key/token management. Monitoring, Detection & Risk Assessment • Implement continuous monitoring of AI identity behavior, including access patterns, privilege use, and anomalous activity. • Detect and investigate identity‑based risks and threats, such as excessive permissions, credential misuse, lateral movement, or abuse of AI agents. • Leverage telemetry from identity platforms, cloud providers, and AI security tools to assess ongoing AI identity risk. AI Security Assessments & Control Validation • Conduct security assessments focused on AI identity usage, including architecture reviews, threat modeling, and control effectiveness testing. • Validate that AI identity controls are correctly implemented and enforced across development, testing, and production environments. • Partner with engineering teams to remediate identified gaps and track risk reduction over time. Governance, Standards & Compliance • Support development and operationalization of AI identity security standards, patterns, and control requirements, aligned with NIST, ISO, and emerging AI guidance. • Track regulatory, legal, and industry expectations related to identity, access, and AI accountability. • Provide evidence, reporting, and metrics to support audits, risk reviews, and governance forums. Documentation, Reporting & Metrics • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), design patterns, and runbooks for AI identity security. • Produce clear reports on AI identity posture, including coverage, risk, and remediation progress. • Contribute to AI identity KPIs and KRIs, such as unmanaged identities, privilege levels, and anomalous activity trends. Advisory, Training & Enablement • Act as a trusted advisor on AI identity security, providing guidance on secure patterns and operational best practices. • Educate engineering and platform teams on AI identity risks, controls, and monitoring expectations. • Support internal communities of practice focused on AI security, IAM modernization, and responsible AI adoption. Research, Experimentation & Continuous Improvement • Stay current on emerging trends in AI agents, autonomous systems, and non‑human identity security. • Design and execute proofs of concept (POCs) to evaluate new AI identity security tools, controls, and monitoring approaches. • Continuously improve AI identity security through automation, integration, and control refinement. Qualifications • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field. • Strong experience in identity and access management, security engineering, or security operations, with exposure to AI or highly automated systems. • Expertise in Least Agency frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, Delegated Authority Management, Cryptographic Identities, and Short Lived Credentialing. • Practical experience securing non‑human identities, service accounts, APIs, or machine‑to‑machine access. • Understanding of AI/ML architectures and how identities are used across data pipelines, model execution, and agent‑based systems. • Proven ability to design, assess, and operationalize identity controls at scale. • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate identity risk into actionable security outcomes. • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, CIAM/IAM‑related certifications, or cloud security certifications are desirable. This role aligns to the NICE Cybersecurity Workforce Framework, with primary alignment to Identity and Access Management, Security Control Assessment, Cybersecurity Architecture, Systems Security Management, and Incident Response work roles. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. Desirable: • Experience of of working with Microsoft technologies. • IT Security experience The ideal candidate for this position should: • Continually look at the market and competition to identify trends and new technologies that will benefit the company. • Identify areas for continuous improvement and provide thoughtful and sustainable solutions. • Be skilled at explaining technical problems succinctly and clearly. • Be able to communicate your vision and roadmap effectively to a wide variety of stakeholders. • Always look for potential solutions to solve problems. title: Senior Network Engineer
jobDescription:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Title and Summary Senior Network Engineer Overview • Supports and assists with the design, architecture, implementation, security and support of a multi-site network communication environment. Role

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Manage and implement a range of network projects. • Develop detailed requirements for upgrading existing production, corporate and non-production network devices. • Participates in the planning and implementing upgrading existing production and corporate and non-production network devices. • Completes network communications troubleshooting and provides in-depth technical assistance with operational problems. • Supports assigned projects, which include responsibility for planning, time, resource utilization and implementation of changes (in and out of core hours). Identifying risks relating to the project, escalating potential concerns, and helping to prevent further design updates and missed requirements. Including: • Cross-team collaboration and engagement with different teams to obtain the necessary information to complete the project and overcome obstacles. • Engagement with the change process and operations management. • Supports Vendor management. • Identifies service improvement activities that would optimise the network's performance, efficiency, and capacity. • Performs baseline checks on new hardware to ensure it complies with company standards and aligns with the current security posture. • Support peers with knowledge sharing and reviewing work All About You Experiences • Three to five years of overall IT experience in the following areas:
- Networking, including LAN/WAN
- Firewalls
- Security and encryption technologies
- Load Balancing • Experience with TCP/IP protocol communications. • Broad knowledge of Cisco’s product portfolio. • Knowledge of Network diagnostics, BGP, SNMP, VPN, SSH, MPLS technologies. • Work in a heavily regulated environment with DSS/PCI compliance. Skills/ Abilities: • Strong verbal and written communication skills. • Self-starter with demonstrated listening skills. • Serves as a mentor to lower-level employees, leads others, and uses good judgment. • Limited supervision: work may be reviewed for direction and strategy. • Ability to identify and formulate a plan to implement improvements in line with colleagues' agreement when completing work. • Holds a current CCNP certification or equivalent experience. Work Conditions: • Supports a 24 by 7 Global Network. • May require occasional travel. • Hybrid Working Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. jobDescription: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Title and Summary Senior Software Engineer Software Engineer – Dev Cloud, Platform & Container Enablement About the Role Software Engineers in this role focus on enabling developer productivity and platform reliability through strong cloud, container, and internal developer platform (IDP) capabilities. You will design, build, and support Dev Cloud solutions that power secure, scalable, and developer-friendly experiences across the organization. This role blends software engineering, platform engineering, and operational excellence, with a strong emphasis on Docker Desktop support, Backstage, AWS, and cloud-native tooling. All team members are expected to demonstrate Mastercard Way cultural values—own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk-taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive—with a relentless focus on developer experience and customer outcomes. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate Dev Cloud capabilities that enable engineers to develop, test, and deploy software efficiently and securely. Own and support Docker Desktop and container-based development workflows, including troubleshooting developer issues and improving local-to-cloud parity. Build and extend Backstage as an internal developer platform, including software templates, plugins, golden paths, and service catalogs. Develop and maintain cloud-native services and automation on AWS, leveraging managed services and infrastructure-as-code practices. Partner with application teams to onboard services to Dev Cloud and Backstage, improving consistency, discoverability, and operational readiness. Automate and simplify developer workflows across build, test, deploy, and runtime operations. Introduce new tools, patterns, and architectures aligned with enterprise engineering standards. Drive reliability, observability, and security best practices across platform services. Collaborate cross-functionally with security, infrastructure, and application teams to resolve complex, multi-service issues. Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and platform excellence. All about you-Technical Focus Areas Dev Cloud & Platform Engineering: Internal platforms, self-service capabilities, golden paths, and developer experience optimization. Containers & Local Development: Docker Desktop, container orchestration concepts, and developer tooling support. Backstage: Software catalogs, templates, plugins, integrations, and adoption strategies. Cloud (AWS): Core AWS services, IAM, networking, compute, storage, monitoring, and cost-aware design. Automation & Ia C: CI/CD, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code to enable repeatable, secure environments. Observability & Operations: Logging, metrics, tracing, and operational readiness in cloud-native environments. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe our differences enable us to be a better team — one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results. Technology at Mastercard What we create today will define tomorrow: revolutionary technologies that reshape the digital economy to be more connected and inclusive than ever before — safer, faster, and more sustainable. We need technologists who are energized by the challenges of a truly global network, with the talent and vision to create the critical systems and products that power global commerce and connect people everywhere to the vital goods and services they need every day. Working at Mastercard means being part of a unique culture that is inclusive, diverse, and built on collaboration. It is a place that celebrates your strengths, values your experiences, and offers the flexibility to shape a career across disciplines and continents — while working alongside experts and leaders at every level of the business to improve what exists and invent what’s next. All About You Are you a technical program manager who wants to work for a company that offers above-and-beyond benefits, including paid parental leave, flexible work hours, gift matching, and volunteer incentives? Do you want to work in an inclusive and nurturing culture that encourages your professional learning and development? About the Role • Drive transformational change in end-to-end product delivery by applying technical program management and engineering best practices across agile and hybrid environments. • Lead large enterprise technical programs and products from inception to delivery, operating autonomously in ambiguous problem spaces. • Maintain a deep understanding of business domains, systems, and architectural decisions, translating complexity into clarity and execution. • Provide thought leadership, drive problem decomposition, accelerate delivery, and ensure predictable outcomes under tight deadlines. • Establish trusted partnerships with engineering, business, and executive stakeholders, influencing decisions and aligning execution. • Build, lead, and mature a high-performing TPM function, fostering strong delivery culture, empathy, and accountability.
